Privacy policy and terms

Last updated 11 November 2026

Who we are

MakersBridge is a small campus merchandise marketplace run by Varit Mesri in Thailand. Contact: varit.mes@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • Account: your email address or phone number, and a password if you use one (we never see it in plain text). If you sign in with Google, we receive your email address from Google. We do not receive your Google password.
  • Orders: what you ordered, sizes, quantities, totals, status and date.
  • We do not collect addresses, ID numbers or card numbers on this site.

Why we use it

To let you sign in, save and manage your orders, run preorders, contact you about an order, and keep the shop safe (for example, limiting abuse). We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

Who processes it

Your data is stored with Supabase (database and sign-in service). Google handles sign-in if you choose it. A text-message provider handles phone codes. These services process data only to provide their function.

How long we keep it

While your account exists, and orders for as long as needed for records and refunds. Security logs of admin changes are kept for safety.

Your rights (PDPA)

You may ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, by emailing the address above. We will reply within 30 days.

Terms of use

  • This is an early service. Preorders go ahead only when the minimum number of people is reached; if not, deposits are refunded.
  • Prices and stock can change. An order is confirmed only after payment is marked as received.
  • Do not misuse the site, attempt to break it, or place false orders. We may close accounts that do.
  • Seller products are made by independent creators. Contact us about any problem with an order.
